items.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills eight people
items.description: The storm cut power to more than 20,000 households and left 7,000 people stranded at Tokyo's Narita airport.

items.title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
items.description: A new US report said China had moved goods through nations with lower tariffs to dodge higher levies.

items.title: Engine parts smashed Ryanair window that man's head was sucked out of, report says
items.description: A preliminary report by US investigators says an engine fan blade broke on last month's flight from Greece to Germany.

items.title: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
items.description: Thousands of sailors on the USS Abraham Lincoln have reportedly faced food shortages and broken plumbing, with some considering jumping overboard.

items.title: Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil
items.description: A man is arrested after eight works by the French artist are found at a home in greater São Paulo.

items.title: Vote counting suspended in Zambia over alleged attacks on polling staff
items.description: The electoral commission said violence had "resulted in the theft of marked ballot papers".

items.title: US missionary released following kidnap in Niger, Christian group says
items.description: Kevin Rideout, who was kidnapped outside his home in the capital last October, is now with US officials.
